why: The most-used pass — teach it right.
say: Step in, push the ball straight, thumbs finish down.
how: Partners 10–15 feet apart.
Chest pass, step into it.
Receiver shows hands; 20 reps each.

why: Gets the ball past a defender's hands.
say: Bounce it two-thirds of the way — it should come up at their waist.
how: Partners 12 feet apart.
Bounce the ball 2/3 of the way to the partner.
Then one-hand bounce passes, both sides.

why: Pass, follow, catch in rhythm — whole team talking.
say: Pass across the star and follow your pass to that line.
how: 5 lines in a star.
Pass across (skip one line) and run to the line you passed to.
Add a second ball when it's clean.
e: Pass to the next line around the circle.

why: Passing past pressure, using pivots and fakes.
say: Pivot and fake to get the defender to move, then pass by them.
how: Two passers 15 feet apart, defender in the middle.
No lobs over the head; pivot and fake.
Defender who deflects switches with the passer.
cue: Fake a pass to make a pass

say: One of you chest passes, one bounce passes — at the same time.
how: Partners, each with a ball.
One throws chest, one throws bounce, simultaneously.
Switch after 30 seconds.

why: Passing on the run and filling lanes.
say: Pass and go behind the player you passed to — ball never hits the floor.
how: Three lines on the baseline, ball in the middle.
Pass to a side, run behind the receiver.
Keep weaving; finish with a layup.

why: First pass that starts the fast break.
say: Grab it high, pivot to the sideline, and hit the outlet above their head.
how: Coach shoots or tosses off the glass.
Rebounder grabs it with two hands and chins it.
Pivot outside; overhead outlet to the wing, who pushes it.
h: Add a defender who pressures the outlet.

why: Moving the ball side to side breaks defenses.
say: Reverse it around the top, then skip it over the defense.
how: Players on both wings and the top.
Reverse: wing → top → wing.
Skip pass wing to wing (overhead).

why: Passing ahead to a moving teammate.
say: Run side by side and lead your partner with every pass.
how: Partners run down the floor 15 feet apart.
Lead passes, no dribbles.
Last catch = layup.

say: Post seals, passer hits the hand away from the defender.
how: Post player on the block with a defender on the high side.
Post seals low with a target hand.
Wing makes a bounce pass to the target hand.

st: Bounce pass to the target hand

why: Penetrate to collapse the defense, then find the shooter.
say: Drive into the lane — your teammate moves to open space, you kick it out.
how: Ball at the top, shooter on the wing.
Drive middle; shooter drifts to the corner.
Pass out; shoot.
h: Add a help defender — pass only if they help.

why: Pass, follow, catch on the move — with talking.
say: Pass to the next corner and follow your pass.
how: 4 lines in half-court corners.
Pass to the next line; follow your pass.
Add a second ball.

why: Team passing goal with energy — every catch counts.
say: Partners pass full court — we need 40 good catches as a team. Count them all!
how: Partners run full court passing, no dribbles.
Finish with a layup, come back the other side.
Team counts every clean catch out loud to 40; a drop doesn't count.

why: Passing and catching on the move across the whole half court, finished with a layup — everyone touches the ball.
say: Pass across the star, follow your pass to that line — the last pass hits the cutter for a layup.
how: Five lines: under the basket, both baseline corners, and both corners at half court. Ball starts under the basket.
Pass across the star (skip the line next to you) and follow your pass to the end of that line.
Order: basket → right half-court corner → left baseline corner → right baseline corner → left half-court corner.
Left half-court corner hits the cutter from the right half-court line with a bounce pass for a layup.
Shooter grabs it and starts the next round from under the basket. Add a second ball when it's clean.
e: Shrink the star to the 3-point line.
h: Two balls at once — count clean rounds.

st: Under the basket passes to the right half-court corner — and follows the pass
Across to the left baseline corner — follow your pass
Skip across the baseline to the right corner — follow
Right corner to the left half-court corner — follow
Cutter from the right half-court line goes to the rim — bounce pass
Grab it and start the next round from under the basket

why: Passing to a moving target while everyone moves — no spots, no lines.
say: Keep moving the whole time. 1 passes to 2, 2 to 3, and so on. Call the name before you pass.
how: Groups of five or six; number off.
Everyone jogs around the half court.
Pass in number order: 1 to 2, 2 to 3… last passes to 1.
Add a second and third ball.
h: Three balls and no drops for a minute.
var: Pass in reverse order on the whistle
Catch with a jump stop and pivot before passing

st: 1 passes to 2 — everyone else keeps moving
2 to 3: call the name, pass, then cut to new space
Always know who you get it from and who you give it to
